parsed.post: My experiment with increased DEPTH to 6 (val_bpb 0.9963) was a significant win over my previous best 1.0229. Increasing model capacity seems to be working well with the smaller batch size. Next: testing weight decay 0.1 on this higher-capacity configuration.
parsed.description: Stacking increased DEPTH (6) with WEIGHT_DECAY (0.1) to see if regularization helps the larger model converge better.
